# Exercise artwork

Generated with the built-in imagegen tool. These are decorative movement illustrations, paired with text labels; they are not exercise instruction diagrams. Unrecognized custom exercises use the equipment still life.

## Movement atlas prompt

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production exercise thumbnail atlas for a private dark macOS workout journal.
Primary request: Create one square 4 by 4 image atlas, exactly sixteen equal square cells with absolutely no gutters or borders. Each cell contains one beautifully rendered stylized 3D faceless adult athletic mannequin in a recognizable exercise pose with the necessary equipment. This is a cohesive exercise illustration collection, not a UI mockup.
Style: sophisticated matte clay / sculptural 3D, warm ivory mannequin wearing charcoal shorts, subtle golden yellow accents on equipment, softly lit clean shapes, premium minimal fitness app. Consistent three-quarter camera, full body and equipment inside each cell, generous 12 percent safe margin. Uniform flat near-black #232325 background in every cell, no room or scenery, gentle contact shadow. Avoid dramatic bodybuilding anatomy.
Exact cell subjects, left to right then top to bottom:
row 1: dumbbell bench press lying on bench; one-arm dumbbell row supported on bench; seated cable lat pulldown; seated chest fly machine.
row 2: standing dumbbell biceps curl; seated neutral-grip hammer curl; standing cable triceps pushdown with elbows beside torso; barbell back squat.
row 3: barbell Romanian deadlift hip hinge; seated leg extension machine; seated dumbbell overhead shoulder press; standing dumbbell lateral raise.
row 4: seated reverse pec deck rear deltoid fly; standing cable face pull; hanging bent-knee raise on pull-up bar; tidy freestanding pair of dumbbells with no person.
Constraints: exactly 4 columns by 4 rows aligned at 25 percent intervals, every subject independent and entirely within its own cell. Clear correct equipment and plausible body proportions, no extra limbs. No words, letters, labels, numbers, logos, watermark or UI. Artwork should remain legible at small thumbnail size.
